title: Vaping Feedback Sent by Public, Educational Institutions, Police and Central Narcotics Bureau
what_it_is: Vaping Feedback Sent by Public, Educational Institutions, Police and Central Narcotics Bureau

sections.label: Multi-agency vaping enforcement approach
sections.summary: HSA leads enforcement with support from NEA, NParks and ICA, schools act to prevent vaping, and vaping-related offences numbered about 7,600, 5,600 and 8,000 in 2021, 2022 and 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are taking a multi-agency collaborative approach to enforcement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hence, while HSA is primarily a scientific agency with a modestly-sized enforcement team, it is supplemented by outsourcing and enforcement support from other agencies such as the National Environment Agency (NEA), National Parks Board (NParks) and Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our schools also take an active approach to prevent students from picking up the habit of vaping.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There were about 7,600, 5,600 and 8,000 vaping-related offences in 2021, 2022 and 2023 respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Of the vaping-related offences, about 4,700, 5,000, 7,900 were purchase, use and possession offences in the same three years.

sections.label: Tobacco Act under HSA purview
sections.summary: At this juncture, it comes under the Tobacco (Control of Advertisements and Sale) Act, which is under HSA's purview.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: At this juncture, it comes under the Tobacco (Control of Advertisements and Sale) Act, and that is something that is under the purview of HSA.

sections.label: NEA officers empowered against vaporiser possession
sections.summary: Since 1 December 2023, NEA enforcement officers have been empowered to act against individuals possessing vaporisers, and cases have been referred to HSA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Since 1 December 2023, NEA's enforcement officers have been empowered to take action against individuals who possess vaporisers and cases have been referred to HSA.

sections.label: HSA doing enforcement
sections.summary: At this juncture, HSA is the one doing the enforcement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: At this juncture, yes, HSA is the one that is doing the enforcement.

sections.label: Guidelines and protocols being looked at
sections.summary: Guidelines and protocols are being looked at, and there is some understanding between agencies for an integrated approach to address the whole problem.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In terms of whether there will be guidelines and protocols in place, yes, that is something that is being looked at.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: At the moment, there is some understanding between the different agencies as to how to make this work meaningfully so that we are having an integrated approach that will help to address the whole problem.
